answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, weighted by independent path length, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the dune of a task receipt, and the haven is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the jade of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
